title: NUD 112 - Fundamentals of Nursing Care: Hygiene, Comfort and Observation

items.q: The statement “checking a patient's consciousness, pupils and limb movement” describes which of the following?
o: Intake and output chart
Deterioration
Neurological observation
Monitoring
items.s: Neurological observation is checking a patient's consciousness, pupils and limb movement.

recording observations and care on the correct form

items.s: Vital signs: the basic measures of body function that show a patient's condition. The other options describe Activities of daily living, Charting, Blood pressure.

items.s: Supine position: lying flat on the back with the face turned upwards. The other options describe Occupied bed, Subjective data, Linen change.

items.s: Personal hygiene is the practices a person uses to keep the body clean and healthy.
